Our courses are Approved by Qualsafe Awards, an Awarding Organisation and recognised by Ofqual to offer regulated qualifications. Sussex First Aid Courses believe in high-quality instructors with considerable real-life experienced offer Bespoke training which is tailored to your needs. We are Qualsafe regulated and offer nationally recognised courses that Interesting and interactive learning in a friendly environment and focus on building knowledge, skills and confidence."
